The Rock (Dwayne Johnson) or Arnold Schwarzenegger in his prime?

I think Arnold in his prime was actually too big. Like, he wouldn't be able to effectively utilize his strength into strikes just because he wouldn't be flexible enough to hit correctly. Due to that, I think the Rock takes this.

The Great One vs. The Terminator

The Rock Hgt: 6'5" Wgt: 260lbs NCAA Football Champion, Professional Wrestler

Arnold Hgt: 6'2" Wgt: 250lbs Powerlifter, Mr. Universe, Experienced street/bar fighter

I'm giving this to The Rock 9/10 times. Even though Arnold used to get into fights I don't think he has enough experience to counter the years of wrestling The Rock has.

If we take each at their prime, we would probably be looking at Duane at the peak of his wrestling career and Arnold around the Commando era. Both are extremely physically fit, with Arnold having the edge in raw strength, but Duane being more athletic overall.

Duane was billed at 6'5, 260lbs, while Arnold was 6'2 and 235lbs. Both heights are likely exaggerated a bit, but we'll go with that. I couldn't find a reach for either, but Duane probably has at least an inch or two advantage.

I think it would come down to fighting ability and style, where Duane would have the edge. While wrestling of his type isn't real fighting, many of the moves and general physical skills would be useful. Arnold had some basic training from military advisors on his films, but likely not much real practice.

If Arnold could grapple well he might be able to overcome Duane, but I think it's much more likely that The Terminator is about to get a face full of the People's Elbow.
In Arnold's biography it says he got in fights regularly in his youth. Pretty much every day he was out looking for fights. He has plenty of experience for this kind of situation.

I thought about that also, but then I weighed the normal fights between a boxer and a wrestler, then took it a little further by comparing a semi-experienced brawler with a wrestler. Arnold just doesn't have the knowledge to defend against a takedown/ground and pound/submission.
(Disclaimer - I'm fully aware pro wrestling is scripted and the fights are not real, I'm also going on the assumption that Arnold has never had any formal training)

That's a tough call. Although since I know nothing about them personally, I'm going to go with movie-level prime. Excluding the special effects, as best I can tell them.

So we've got the Rock from Fast and Furious, and Arnie from Terminator 2, minus the robotic body.

Arnie's got brute force, but so's the Rock. As far as what I know, Arnie's pumped iron and done the Mr. Universe thing or whatever. Lotsa muscles, lotsa discipline, dunno about fighting abilities. The Rock's got wrestling, which for what it is, it still requires fight-based training and how to handle and manipulate another body working against you.

My money's on the Rock.
